title: Project APEX
description: A discontinued sales-agent prototype with guided voice onboarding and live brief review; ended after the development collaboration did not work out.
body:
Project APEX was an autonomous sales-agent prototype built around collecting business context before attempting outreach, qualification, or follow-up work. The project has been discontinued.

## Why we stopped

The development collaboration did not work out, and we decided to end the project. There is no active continuation planned for APEX.

## What was built

The prototype combined a focused black-and-white interface with a working intake backend. Users could speak through their business context while a brief took shape in the background, review the captured information, and approve the handoff.

Source collection, answer extraction, and the final handoff were separated to reduce repeated questions and preserve the context already captured. The landing page and working onboarding flow were brought into the same application.

## What remains

The project documents an approach to guided voice onboarding and reviewable agent context. Those implemented foundations are the outcome; the broader autonomous-sales roadmap was not completed.
